args.body: Finish RENEWAL-FRAMEWORK-ACCESS-DECISION with the saved official sources rather than another extraction loop. Successful FETCH receipts establish g-cloud-14.html and tepas2.html; check the third queued receipt before using its artifact. Read agreement-extracts.json in bounded ranges. Produce the concise EN/FR decision note and evidence now: G-Cloud 14 expired 28 October 2026, existing signed call-offs retain their defined terms, and the source directs new requirements to G-Cloud 15. Do not infer access to that successor. Explain TePAS2's documented buying methods and agreement dates only from readable source quotations; keep joining, call-off participation and subcontracting UNKNOWN wherever unsupported. Preserve HSE's conflicting structured and descriptive routes. Give practical conditional supplier next steps, distinguishing recommendations from official requirements and contract end dates from open opportunities. No additional discovery beyond the original three-page bound, public edits, deployment or spending. Read the saved finished artifacts, reconcile actual ownership and complete with a valid lease and a lesson covering what worked, failed and would change the decision. Preserve all observation and retirement duties. Missing classified feedback is unknown demand, not zero demand; this work establishes no revenue.

description: Official evidence now shows G-Cloud 14 expired on 28 October 2026 while existing call-offs remain effective. This changes the supplier decision: a 2027 contract end date alone does not establish an accessible competition. Finish the bounded supplier-access note using saved sources. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown; funding and revenue remain unverified. The CSV deployment rejection affects that release only; reconsider it when new host-gate evidence appears.
